title: Lists in HTML
description: Lists are used to display related information in an organized format.
HTML provides ordered lists (<ol>) for numbered items and unordered lists (<ul>) for bulleted items.
Each item within a list is defined using the <li> tag.
Lists are commonly used for displaying steps, instructions, menus, features, or any information that needs to be grouped together in a clear and structured manner.
